newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Commercial Bank 1996 profit up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Commercial Bank 1996 profit up 21 pct.

text.p: Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) posted a 21 percent increase in pre-tax profit to 733 million rupees ($35.7 million) for the year ending 30 June 1996, the bank's financial accounts published on Thursday showed.
MCB's operating profit for the financial year 1995/96 was also up 21 percent to 703 million rupees and profit after tax for the same time period rose 14 percent to 537 million rupees.
The MCB is the largest commercial bank in this Indian Ocean island with deposits totalling 31.9 billion rupees as at 30 June 1996 as compared to 28.2 billion rupees one year earlier.
The MCB also has subsidiaries in the neighbouring Indian Ocean islands and in the French capital, Paris.
